    The ray category of a connected algebra is connected #

    If a split basic algebra B has no central idempotent other than 0 and 1 (for instance if B is minimal representation-infinite), the fundamental groupoid of its ray category is connected (SplitBasicData.isConnected_fund): otherwise the sum of the idempotents of one component would be central.
